name: Tsukuba Muneshige
source:
Hatsuhime's servant, and loyal samurai and clan vassal. He has a penchant for making terrible jokes and bad impressions, which he sometimes uses to try to cheer Hatsuhime/Sayori up. Unfortunately, his impressions can get himself into trouble, as well.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yo-Jin-Bo#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
